explanation_en: On ball 8.5, Shubman Gill scored 1 run off CV Varun. Your player Shubman Gill gained +5.0 points, increasing your team total to 163.5 points, but your simulated rank dropped by 166 to 1305 because other teams in the pool gained more points on this ball.
